claim: The one-click sample is populated, resets cleanly, and never changes saved projects.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a saved project, enter /demo, edit and reset the sample, then return to the unchanged project

claim: A new free board starts with four editable panels.
sandbox: fresh /demo state; create a new sample project and count editable panel cards

claim: A board tracks appearance references, named attributes, props, and per-panel links.
where: landing preview, how it works, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; inspect populated references, attributes, props, coverage, and panel form links

claim: JSON backup exports and restores a board.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; download JSON, change the sample workspace, then import the downloaded file and verify restoration

claim: JSON and print/PDF output include supplied reference credit.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; inspect the downloaded JSON and print-media output for the sample credit

claim: Normal board use keeps project data in the browser and sends no cross-origin requests.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; record every request while editing a panel and prop, then require product-origin requests only

claim: The product has no accounts, image generation, copyrighted templates, public gallery, or collaboration flow.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; require original sample attribution and verify no account, generation, publishing, gallery, or invitation action exists

claim: The board works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: own fresh browser context at /demo; wait for worker control, go offline, reload, and edit the sample

claim: Continuity Board installs as a standalone PWA.
sandbox: own fresh browser context at /demo; require worker control and a standalone manifest with 192, 512, and maskable icons

claim: An available app update is shown and applied only after confirmation.
sandbox: own fresh browser context; install the shipped v9 worker fixture, enter /demo, accept the v10 notice, and verify the active worker/cache

claim: A valid $12 one-time Studio license enables panels 5–12 and project duplication.
where: landing pricing, Studio dialog, terms, README
sandbox: start at /demo, leave for a clean real board, fulfill Sociobot verification with a recorded valid fixture, then add 12 panels and duplicate

claim: Studio checkout uses the product-specific Sociobot billing endpoint and no payment form is embedded.
sandbox: fresh browser context; inspect the rendered Studio purchase destination and require no card input in the product

claim: License state stays in localStorage, only the token is sent to Sociobot, and a valid result is cached for one day.
sandbox: start at /demo, leave for real mode, record a valid Sociobot fixture request, inspect localStorage, reload, and require no second request or card field

claim: An inactive Studio license removes paid actions but keeps saved projects and JSON export available.
sandbox: start at /demo, create a five-panel board with a valid fixture, age the cached verdict, return a revoked fixture, and verify project and export access

claim: Clearing browser site data removes saved projects and local license state.
sandbox: start at /demo, create a real saved project and local license state, clear IndexedDB and localStorage, then reload to an empty workspace

claim: The browser keeps multiple local projects and restores them after reload.
sandbox: start at /demo, leave for a clean real workspace, create two projects, switch, reload, and verify both

claim: The board supports a 390 px screen, keyboard use, and reduced motion.
sandbox: fresh /demo at 390 by 844 with reduced motion; verify reflow, skip focus, named dialog keyboard operation, focus return, and reduced transitions
